payload.text: ONE HEAVY RUN ON THE HOST AT A TIME, BETWEEN vc AND cc (started on 2026-09-24 for Intent's 3.2.1 cut; after the cut, on 2026-09-25, vc kept it for our own box). A full suite, a mutant batch or a multi-file bats run is heavy; a single arm or a small targeted filter is light and always allowed. Start a heavy run only on vc's START, and send vc END the moment it finishes, with the pid and the times read from the machine. SUSPENDED on 2026-10-05 on hv's word, relayed by vc: run the tests now, in parallel, with no START or END. Back in force when vc says so; retire this when vc says the protocol has ended.
